phenomenon: Initial project Skill commit landed on a branch switched concurrently by another task in the shared worktree.
cause: Branch checked only at task start; no exclusive worktree ownership/recheck immediately before staging and commit.
preserved_other_task: No other backend dirty changes staged/reverted; parallel branch left in place; independent new worktree created from own committed snapshot.
scope: Add a narrowly scoped source/worktree revalidation guard; no ECS mutation or extra approval layer for unchanged verified tasks.
